issues.title: Y-axis label collision
issues.description: Y-axis grid label overlaps directly with candlestick bars and wicks, degrading legibility.
issues.evidence: The '105.0' text label collides directly with the central red and green candles.
issues.suggestion: Offset Y-axis labels to the margin or place them in a dedicated gutter outside the data area.
issues.triageNote: Confirmed in source: gridline label rows are flex rows that inherit page dir; under dir=rtl the label span flips from the right-axis gutter onto the physically-positioned candles. Fixed by dir="ltr" isolation on the chart container.
